verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's billing docs say idle Ducklings shut down automatically, so idle compute costs nothing. Per-second billing and usage SQL views with a billing dashboard support cost visibility. Fixed per-workload instance sizes limit how much compute any one workload can use, but nothing shown actually halts a runaway query or enforces a spend limit. Missing for 10: budgets or spend caps, budget alerts, query timeouts or resource monitors that kill runaway queries, details on auto-suspend timing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
